needs.premise: One canonical operation in domain1, original writer and helper, delayed stores, old/new head observations and one decision; ordinary and helper-entry profiles; atomic head/decision effects, complete stop certificates and root/layout/domain custody are premises; not C weak-memory, arbitrary machine interruption or liveness proof

23 conditional declarations: link reconciliation/idempotence, ACK observation ambiguity, generation does not drain, stop/takeover gates, decision/query Step/Trace and derived-credit conservation; not every QNT transition or C source simulation

Immutable LinkIntent publishes exact operation/VM/domain/generation, fresh node not already in the well-formed old chain, old head, body proof, root and allocation tickets before first link effect; journal ACKs follow data and may lag it; helpers never trust partly prepared record or ACK absence alone; intent, root cells, domain and native code backing outlive all original/helper borrowers

Controlled cohort uses real atomic native head with all readers adapted; under stable exclusive domain authority after prior writer stop, head==old permits reconstruction of node.next from immutable intent then release publication, head==node with next==old confirms success without reinsertion, every other head/shape refuses; next remains immutable after head visibility until exclusive sweep; no mixing atomic head with old raw PSTATE stores

StopCertificate names exact operation, writer/thread incarnation, domain lease and every helper lineage; normal cooperative endpoint closes future stores, or exact successful native termination/join plus drained final effects supports native stop; logical Scheme exit, generation increment, timeout, pthread id reuse or failed/ignored join do not; known stop alone does not recover locks, freed storage or invalid structure

Commit publishes one pre-backed immutable DecisionEnvelope pointer by atomic compare-exchange after body/list/root installation; envelope holds stable root handles and allocation ticket, not untracked movable SCMOBJ; ticket role reserved/live and result come from same decision; no scalar increment/decrement replay; null before stop is pending observation, nonnull qualifies committed result but not writer drain

Unknown head/commit result retains operation, root and domain lease; after known stop helpers reconcile actual atomic head/decision, finish exact existing operation and never allocate/free or jump native frame from query; committed outcome with pending writers still refuses GC freeze; GC coordinator does not block holding a lock needed by target/helper, no join/GC barrier wait cycle

DataWriteClosed covers original and all helpers before lease withdrawal and GC freeze; raw already-issued stores are not revoked by token change; protected metadata readers may outlive heap-write closure but prevent control/decision reuse; no ABA reuse while old borrowers can issue effect; move operation/domain/root backing to VM service before PSTATE cleanup and preserve committed result custody separately from native activation

Actual C acquire/release and atomic object layout refine immutable-intent visibility, next-before-head publication, observed head classification and one decision CAS; all accesses use compatible types and lifetime protection; compiler/target lock-free support is not assumed, owner-death inside nonrecoverable atomic/lock backend remains unsupported; stop certificates establish no future effects before freeze/reuse

Pre-backed entry root slots admit explicit procedure or frozen actual RC closure data/code lease before any capacity check, native allocation or possible GC; root enrollment shares epoch membership admission, rejected enrollment preserves upstream rooted custody; private raw storage contains no untracked SCMOBJ; reload collector-updated input slot only after publication permit; foreign-thread and mutable closure origin require qualified binding

One canonical operation holds VM-epoch publisher lease plus exclusive physical-domain link authority; bounded nonallocating fragments fill body, write next/head, install reserved root, commit result and live credit, then withdraw lease; raw refcount0, header/length/mark valid before link; all GC/header/root/diagnostic observers honor the lease/commit boundary; never hold capacity lock across grant or permit while requesting GC

Close new root/publisher enrollment first, retain precise active operation set, drain known publisher/root writers without holding a lock they need, freeze matching root and physical-list membership, retain frozen input-root cells through failed native result/rollback until view drain, setup every domain then mark; same-domain link serialization prevents lost head updates, split domains can publish concurrently; resize/teardown cannot remove an active domain or invalidate permit identity

Known private pre-permit failure uses matched allocator disposition; unknown malloc/free keeps canonical input root and capacity debt without replay; after any visible list/root fragment the service retains permit and rolls forward only after original writer stop and valid complete journal/layout, never guessed unlink/free; unknown writer stop or partial structure blocks freeze, not converted into isolated native debt; response loss alone queries committed result

Reserve exact operation/native/root/control credits before permit; transfer reserved to live once at canonical commit and to returned only on known no-allocation/free, quarantine unknown outcome; reconcile per-domain counters and native-only pending storage across sweep/resize without double-counting legacy requested_words_still or refunded temporary estimate; physical mmap/free backend and actual allocation receipt remain profile-specific

Actual C synchronization must refine membership/grant linearization, per-domain link exclusion, fragment writes before release permit, freeze acquire/revalidation and all-setup-before-mark; input root relocation/write permission and metadata reclamation cannot race ordinary field reads; unknown stop cannot be inferred from missing ACK or a scalar count; lock order excludes GC/allocator/owner cycles

interruptionCosts.removedWork: Avoid duplicate insertion and self-link when head write succeeded but ACK did not
interruptionCosts.bound: 3 outcomes: head old -> reconstruct, head node+next old -> confirm, other -> refuse
interruptionCosts.addedCost: Immutable old-head/node intent, exclusive domain and atomic head read
interruptionCosts.condition: Only after exact prior-writer stop/valid structure; no list search guessing or unbounded retry

interruptionCosts.removedWork: Permit progress ACK to lag real data effect safely
interruptionCosts.bound: 2 link data effects: next then head; separate ACKs never lead data
interruptionCosts.addedCost: Pre-backed intent publication and progress cells; extra stores/observations
interruptionCosts.condition: No durability across process crash claimed; volatile release/acquire source refinement remains open

interruptionCosts.bound: 1 winning decision CAS per operation; 0 scalar credit deltas on selected commit path
interruptionCosts.addedCost: One immutable envelope + root handle/ticket and protected query
interruptionCosts.condition: Atomic profile required; attempts/query count is not bounded to1; no allocation during reconciliation

interruptionCosts.removedWork: Query canonical state without repeating side effects
interruptionCosts.bound: 0 native allocation/free or native jump from outcome query
interruptionCosts.condition: Null before writer drain is Pending, not proven failure; committed decision alone does not permit GC

interruptionCosts.removedWork: Separate logical death and token revocation from physical effect drain
interruptionCosts.bound: Must cover every original/helper writer lineage; pending effects0 before permit release
interruptionCosts.addedCost: Cooperative endpoint or exact successful native termination/join, identity and domain checks
interruptionCosts.condition: Timeout, failed/ignored join, generation change and mere thread-id match are insufficient

interruptionCosts.removedWork: Retain recoverable construction outside dying PSTATE
interruptionCosts.bound: 1 VM service custody handoff before PSTATE cleanup; no post-free reconstruction
interruptionCosts.addedCost: Resize/cleanup ordering and per-domain root/code lifetime integration
interruptionCosts.condition: Current source cleans before exit and ignores join result; no existing native failure is inferred

interruptionCosts.removedWork: Roll forward existing operation instead of reallocate/undo linked object
interruptionCosts.bound: At most1 active effect writer per domain; each helper creates another closure obligation
interruptionCosts.addedCost: Bounded lineage/journal slots; helper must close its own writes too
interruptionCosts.condition: Owner stop alone does not cover helper; unknown lock/structure keeps GC blocked

interruptionCosts.removedWork: Allow metadata readers while excluding future heap/list writers
interruptionCosts.bound: 0 outstanding data effects at freeze; metadata pins need not be0
interruptionCosts.condition: Readers must be control-only; root/object borrowers remain governed by imported view contract

interruptionCosts.removedWork: Keep next immutable after head publication; atomic head is native side storage
interruptionCosts.bound: Inherited marker body remains2W+24 in selected layout; atomic side-record size unspecified
interruptionCosts.addedCost: All controlled-domain head/setup/sweep accessors and code generation must migrate
interruptionCosts.condition: No mixed atomic/plain access; no universal lock-free, ABI or stalled-owner progress guarantee

interruptionCosts.removedWork: Reuse one marker backing through original/helper/service custody
interruptionCosts.addedCost: Add immutable intent/envelope, writer/reader receipts and retained root/code graph
interruptionCosts.condition: Writer/readers may retain records and debt indefinitely; exact sizeof/padding and whole-round peak reduction unproved

interruptionCosts.removedWork: Remove guessed push, repeated scalar debit and duplicate allocation
interruptionCosts.bound: 0 repeat allocation/free in selected reconciliation; one canonical result/ticket role
interruptionCosts.addedCost: Acquire observations, identity checks, journal/stop service and retained records
interruptionCosts.condition: Positive net only if removed duplication/waits/retention exceed new costs; no wall-clock speedup measured

interruptionCosts.removedWork: Generate one typed publication/decision/root service across GC and FFI
interruptionCosts.bound: 0 production paths retired today; 0 Zig-specific necessary-support savings demonstrated
interruptionCosts.addedCost: Same C ABI/root/stop/reclamation obligations for any implementation language
interruptionCosts.condition: Zig adds no native stop proof or automatic GC; source and memory-order gates remain necessary

nodes.labelText: Immutable intent before link\nnode / old head / domain / root tickets
Private next = old head\nwrite may precede journal ACK
Atomic release head = node\nACK may still be absent
Exact writer stop evidence\nlogical death / token change insufficient
Stable exclusive domain\nold / node+next / unexpected head
Reconstruct or confirm once\nno duplicate push / no native replay
Installed rooted result handle\npre-backed immutable DecisionEnvelope
One canonical decision CAS\nresult + ticket role share authority
Null before writer drain = Pending\nnonnull result is not GC permission
Close original + every helper\nretain roots / data-write permit
All data effects drained -> GC freeze\nmetadata-only reader may remain
Unknown stop / lock / structure\nretain custody; refuse freeze
SysML -> ASCENT -> QNT / Lean\nC and platform refinements open

callers.actualChain: Generic still allocator writes next, publishes PSTATE head, then count/length/header; body is caller-filled
callers.hazard: There is no durable per-operation intent or ACK; current sequence is not the selected initialized-before-head profile
callers.replacement: Controlled allocator prepares body/intent privately, atomic controlled-domain head, adapted setup/sweep readers; raw legacy chain remains separately admitted

callers.actualChain: still list/queue and RC chain are per-PSTATE; ALLOC_MEM_LOCK protects capacity
callers.hazard: A scalar memory lock or processor number is not stable domain/writer ownership
callers.replacement: VM-owned domain incarnation and writer lineage; never hold a nonrecoverable lock across interruption assumed recoverable

callers.actualChain: Existing still marking uses CAS; header selects compiler builtins/emulated/sequential synchronization
callers.hazard: Current CAS helper existence proves neither atomic object ABI nor owner-death progress for a new head/decision cell
callers.replacement: New native atomic profile explicitly binds all loads/stores, alignment and backend; emulate only with separately qualified stop-safe lock behavior

callers.actualChain: Setup walks raw still head/next and resets marks; barrier precedes marking
callers.hazard: Observer bypasses managed commit/lease cut if only allocator is changed
callers.replacement: Controlled-domain iterator acquires frozen complete head after publisher closure; all domains setup before any mark

callers.actualChain: Sweep reads next, relinks live objects and recomputes per-PSTATE counts
callers.hazard: Next cannot be rewritten by late helper after sweep starts; source head equality alone lacks ABA protection
callers.replacement: No-future-write closure of all lineages before sweep; controlled/legacy/pending accounting reconciled without dual authoritative counters

callers.actualChain: POSIX starter invokes start_fn; ___thread_exit calls pthread_exit; ___run return can continue sync service loop
callers.hazard: Logical Scheme/processor task completion is not native thread termination
callers.replacement: Distinguish activation-close/cooperative operation endpoint/native termination; certificate identifies exact native incarnation and scope

callers.actualChain: POSIX join wrapper branches on pthread_join return, converts error through errno helper; helper maps errno0 to UNKNOWN_ERR
callers.hazard: Original pthread error value is not retained; success/failure and target identity must remain explicit, not inferred from errno or absence
callers.replacement: Store exact raw join return and successful target incarnation in service receipt; no stopped certificate from ignored/failed/unknown join

callers.actualChain: Shrinking processor cleans PSTATE then exits; P0 joins and ignores result
callers.hazard: Recovery after successful join is too late if PSTATE cleanup already freed operation/node/root backing
callers.replacement: Transfer VM-owned construction/domain duties before cleanup; consume exact join receipt after known quiescence; failed join retains removal debt

callers.actualChain: cleanup_os_and_mem_pstate calls memory cleanup; still/RC freed; VM teardown destroys synchronization
callers.hazard: Native stopped does not reconstruct freed objects or recover a destroyed domain lock
callers.replacement: Service backing/roots/code outlive PSTATE; never issue takeover from join alone after storage destruction

callers.actualChain: setjmp/longjmp TRY machinery and SFUN error loops reuse marker; ___call consumes exact matching return frame
callers.hazard: C stack local progress can disappear; logical unwind does not fence every native helper or foreign writer
callers.replacement: Off-stack operation/intent/result and explicit guarded no-future-write endpoint; native return rights still belong to original live activation

callers.actualChain: Generator emits native entry wrappers; source and generated kernel read marker slots
callers.hazard: Unmigrated raw producer can write after token checks; changing generation does not revoke issued stores
callers.replacement: Typed Scheme-generated entry/closure descriptors and complete raw-writer census; regenerate or reject old module profile

callers.actualChain: Old allocation changes scalar occupied/deferred words; resize request combines and temporarily assumes live space
callers.hazard: Repeating scalar delta after lost commit can charge/refund twice; temporary requested words are not operation outcome
callers.replacement: One canonical allocation ticket role derived from decision; summary counters are reconciled views, never second outcome authority

callers.actualChain: Marker proc copy has GC TODO; dynamic closure uses global self; RC roots per PSTATE, mark_rc only P0 branch
callers.hazard: A stopped native writer and correct head do not establish root completeness or original closure identity
callers.replacement: Pre-backed actual input root, stable handle in decision, all-domain root view and legacy marker gate imported unchanged

callers.actualChain: Native allocation/free can use malloc or mmap backend; void release hides outcome
callers.hazard: Commit reconciliation cannot recover unknown native allocation or infer munmap success
callers.replacement: Retain exact pending/quarantine ticket; no allocation/free in reconciliation, backend-specific original evidence still required

callers.actualChain: Real Tcl command/server/function-valued callbacks instantiate generated native entry and return paths
callers.hazard: Nested callback/delete/error can close logical activation while cleanup result persists
callers.replacement: Keep activation/root/native-resource duties separate from canonical commit, no foreign continuation compatibility assumed

callers.actualChain: GSTATE exposes raw marker and thread functions; teardown can destroy storage independent of external handles
callers.hazard: Plain external pointer or reused thread id cannot validate late query; metadata reclamation is separate from heap collection
callers.replacement: Protected lookup/pin and nonreused operation/writer identities; stable decision/root backing until data writers/readers drain
